title: A Note from Our Founders

At Silver Tide Tech, we believe technology has the power to create meaningful change. But we also believe that the true value of technology lies not in how advanced it is, but in how effectively it improves people's lives.

Our journey begins with a simple belief: innovation should be accessible, practical, and built around real-world needs.

We founded Silver Tide Tech with a vision to build technology products, platforms, and solutions that empower people, simplify work, and create new opportunities. We want to bridge the gap between what technology can achieve and what people actually need.

Our first focus is education — a space where technology can make a lasting difference. Through **SarasTech**, our AI-powered teaching assistant, we are working to support educators with intelligent tools that make teaching more effective, creative, and accessible.

But this is only the beginning.

We see Silver Tide Tech growing across multiple areas of technology and innovation, exploring new ideas, building useful products, and creating solutions that address meaningful challenges.

As we move forward, our focus will remain on three principles:

- **Purpose-driven innovation:** Building technology that solves real problems.
- **People-first thinking:** Keeping people at the centre of everything we create.
- **Long-term impact:** Creating products and solutions that deliver lasting value.

We know that building something meaningful takes curiosity, collaboration, persistence, and continuous learning. We are excited about the possibilities ahead and grateful to everyone who becomes part of this journey.

This is more than building technology. It is about creating possibilities and empowering people through innovation.

**Building Technology. Empowering People.**

**With purpose,**

**The Founders**  
Rajeev Kumar · Devanshu Deo · Abhinav Abhishek · Anuj Shahi · Sachin Kumar

*Founders & Directors, Silver Tide Tech*
